tools.name: search_inventory
tools.description: Searches live luxury watch inventory indexed by MostExpensiveWatches by brand, complication, material, price range or free text. Returns up to 50 listings with brand, reference, asking price in USD, merchant and listing URL.

tools.name: lookup_reference
tools.description: Resolves a watch name or brand and reference to a canonical MEW reference page. Returns reference details, an AI-written description, current listing statistics and the documented auction record with available sources and verification notes.

tools.name: search_auction_comps
tools.description: Searches documented watch auction results by brand, reference, minimum result in USD or sale year. Returns matching lots, reported prices, auction dates, available sources and verification notes. Reference coverage depends on the brand filter and available corpus.

tools.name: list_upcoming_auctions
tools.description: Lists tracked upcoming watch auctions, optionally filtered by auction house. Returns auction names, houses, dates and calendar links.

tools.name: get_market_estimate
tools.description: Returns market evidence for a brand or reference: live asking-price median and range, documented auction record, median auction result and a market signal.

tools.name: get_brand_info
tools.description: Returns a watch brand profile with founding year, tier, country, AI-written biography, inventory counts and dealers carrying the brand.

tools.name: search_answers
tools.description: Searches MEW watch answer pages by query. Returns matching titles, short snippets and answer-page URLs.

tools.name: get_todays_hammer_game
tools.description: Returns today's HAMMER watch-auction game: documented lot details with prices redacted, game number and rules. The game allows six guesses, with a winning tolerance of 10 percent of the documented result.

tools.name: guess_hammer_price
tools.description: Scores one price guess for today's HAMMER game. Returns higher or lower direction, closeness band and the received attempt number. Green means within 10 percent, yellow within 1.5 times and orange within 3 times; red is farther away. The documented result and lot record are revealed on success or at

tools.name: get_site_stats
tools.description: Returns the current MEW catalog snapshot, including counts of listings, brands, merchants, references, auction lots and blog posts.
